text: {"lessons":["Past price changes do not predict future returns, so I should not assume recent gains will continue when deciding what to buy, sell, or hold.","Selling only stocks that are up can reflect reluctance to realize losses; I should assess each holding on its future prospects rather than whether it is above my purchase price.","Repeatedly trimming winning positions may leave me underinvested in them; I should use a consistent portfolio plan instead of letting gains or losses drive my decisions."]}
